title: 第25章 误杀第26章 计划失败
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
随着能力的不断提升，黄夜除了修炼之外，也开始探查城主府。
虽然不知现在能力如何，但他觉得肯定比那些侍卫强。
不过几位护法的院落他没敢探查，武王的实力到底如何，他还不清楚。
那次看到三位武王，身形也是一闪即逝，那次他觉得至少轻功方面赶不上他们。
这一日，三人正在修炼，黄夜突然听到衣袂摆动的声音。
立刻抽出身子，做个嘘声的动作，快速穿好衣服。
来人在二女的房门前停了一会儿，并未进入，又飘到黄夜房门外。
等了一会儿，才转身飘走。
黄夜听了声音的方向，示意二女好好待着，打开窗户窜出去。
两个纵跃后便看到前面一道黑色身影正在快速移动。
追到一处围墙，黑袍人闪身离开城主府。
围墙外正是那处密林。
黄夜立刻窜到围墙之上，双手扒在墙头，看着女子离开的方向。
感觉距离差不多了，翻身过去，继续追踪。
黑袍人行至密林边缘停下来，三下两下，一身黑袍已然脱下，放入一个布包之内。
黄夜远远看着这个露出蓝色宫装的女子，看来你就是那个黑袍人。
这女子怎么不在城主府居住，而是在府外居住。
“系统，我需要跟踪技巧。”
【叮！跟踪技巧大全！…………】此处省略一万字。
卧槽，这么多，早知道先看看好了。

黄夜一边跟上女子，一边看着里面的跟踪术，现学现卖。
一直跟到一处深宅大院，女子敲开大门，闪身入内。
看着大院匾额上的三个大字，黄夜嘿嘿一笑。
你倒是挺谨慎，确定了位置，黄夜顺着原路返回房间。
“少爷，找到人了么？”
“晴儿，你没看错，那个女子确实是城主府的人。”
“她从围墙跳出去，绕了一圈，从正门进了城主府。”
“她应该是来找月儿的，她的实力我还不清楚。不过我感觉可以和她打一架。”
“少爷，不行，您这么做太危险。”
“富贵险中求，你们不懂的，只修炼不对抗，永远是井底之蛙。”
“她这次没找到月儿，近期还能再来。”
“我们设个局，把她撵出去，我到府外跟她打一场试试。”
content_en:
As his abilities continued to improve, in addition to practicing, Huang Ye also began to explore the city lord's mansion.
Although he didn't know what his current abilities were, he felt that he was definitely better than those guards.
However, he did not dare to explore the courtyards of several guardians. He still did not know the strength of King Wu.
That time when he saw the three Martial Kings, their figures also disappeared in a fleeting moment. That time he felt that at least he couldn't keep up with them in terms of Qinggong.
On this day, the three of them were practicing, and Huang Ye suddenly heard the sound of clothes swinging.
He immediately pulled out, made a shushing motion, and quickly got dressed.
The visitor stopped for a while in front of the two girls' room door, but without entering, he floated outside the door of Huang Ye's room again.
After waiting for a while, he turned around and floated away.
Huang Ye heard the direction of the sound, signaled the two girls to stay well, opened the window and rushed out.
After two leaps, they saw a black figure moving quickly in front of them.
After chasing him to a wall, the man in black robe dodged and left the city lord's mansion.
Just outside the wall is the dense forest.
Huang Ye immediately ran to the wall, put his hands on the top of the wall, and looked at the direction the woman was leaving.
Feeling that the distance is almost there, I turn over and continue tracking.
The man in black robe walked to the edge of the dense forest and stopped. With three clicks, he took off his black robe and put it into a cloth bag.
Huang Ye looked at the woman in blue palace attire from a distance. It seems that you are the man in black robe.
Why doesn't this woman live in the city lord's mansion, but outside the mansion?
"System, I need tracking skills."
[Ding! A complete collection of tracking techniques! ………] Ten thousand words are omitted here.
Damn it, there are so many, I should have looked at them if I had known.
Huang Ye kept up with the woman while looking at the tracking techniques inside, learning and selling them now.
Following until they reached a deep house, the woman knocked on the door and ducked in.
Looking at the three big characters on the plaque in the courtyard, Huang Ye chuckled.
You were quite cautious, and after confirming the location, Huang Ye returned to the room along the original path.
"Master, have you found the person?"
"Qing'er, you read that right, that woman is indeed from the City Lord's Mansion."
"She jumped out of the wall, circled around, and entered the city lord's palace through the main entrance."
"She should be here to find Yue'er. I don't know her strength yet. But I feel like I can have a fight with her."
"Master, no, it's too dangerous for you to do this."
"Wealth can be found in danger. You don't understand. If you only practice without fighting, you will always be a frog in the well."
"She didn't find Yue'er this time. She may come again in the near future."
"Let's set up a game and drive her out. I'll try to fight her outside the house."
